guidance.said: The company remains confident of sustaining Wires and Cables EBITDA margins within 11% to 13% over the medium to long term.
guidance.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.said: The company aims to grow its FMEG business at 1.5x to 2x the industry growth rate.
guidance.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.said: The company expects FMEG EBITDA margins to reach a range of 8% to 10% over the long term.
guidance.quote: So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.said: Sustainable EBIT margins for the EPC business are expected to remain in the high single-digit range over the medium to long term.
guidance.quote: Over the medium- to long-term, we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range, supported by disciplined project selection, efficient execution, and a healthy order pipeline.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.said: The working capital cycle is expected to trend towards the long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
guidance.quote: As these benefits gradually normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to trend towards our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.said: The company targets wires and cables volume growth at 1.5x of the overall market growth rate.
guidance.quote: What we have called out already, as an anchor to look into the volume growth, is that whatever the market grows, we will do 1.5x of that in cable and wires.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.said: The Extra High Voltage (EHV) plant commissioning is expected during FY28.
guidance.quote: in terms of our EHV plant timelines, we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

reported.quote: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year, with all business segments contributing meaningfully to this growth momentum.
Profitability remained robust, with profit after tax reaching a record high of INR 9,900 million, representing a 43% year-over-year increase.

EBITDA increased by 39% year-on-year, while EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4%, supported by a favourable business mix and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
Net cash stood at INR 45.2 billion as of September 30th, 2026, compared to INR 29.4 billion a year ago.

During the first half of the year, we incurred capital expenditures of INR 6.1 billion, reflecting our ongoing investments in capacity expansion, supply chain capabilities and future growth platforms.

reported.topic: Wires and Cables segment revenue growth
reported.quote: The Wires and Cables segment delivered a strong quarter, recording 47% year-on-year revenue growth.

business: Polycab India Limited manufactures and sells wires and cables, fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG) including fans, lighting, switches, switchgear, conduits, pipes, fittings, and solar inverters, while also executing EPC projects. Its main operational segments consist of Wires and Cables, FMEG, and EPC.
